description: This file is a Python source code module that parses JSON output from the 'behave' testing framework, converting it into internal model objects representing features, scenarios, steps, and related elements.

classes.name: JsonParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing JSON data into behave model objects, including features, scenarios, steps, backgrounds, and examples.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main function to read a JSON file and return a list of feature objects.

methods.name: parse_features
methods.description: Parses a list of JSON feature data into feature model objects.

methods.name: parse_feature
methods.description: Parses a single JSON feature into a feature model object.

methods.name: add_feature_element
methods.description: Adds a background, scenario, or scenario outline to a feature based on JSON data.

methods.name: parse_background
methods.description: Parses JSON background data into a Background model object.

methods.name: parse_scenario
methods.description: Parses JSON scenario data into a Scenario model object.

methods.name: parse_scenario_outline
methods.description: Parses JSON scenario outline data into a ScenarioOutline model object.

methods.name: parse_steps
methods.description: Parses a list of JSON steps into Step model objects.

methods.name: parse_step
methods.description: Parses a JSON step into a Step model object, including handling of text, table, and result.

methods.name: add_step_result
methods.description: Adds result information (status, duration, error message) to a step.

methods.name: parse_table
methods.description: Parses JSON table data into a Table model object.

methods.name: parse_examples
methods.description: Parses JSON examples data into an Examples model object.
